latest_release.name: SoundCraft v0.18.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* clap-host tests: load plugins only from a freshly created private temp directory by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1295
* MIDI: index controller dedup by channel and kind by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1298
* Mixer: match automation lanes to insert parameters in one merge by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1299
* Mixer: compute cyclic aux depths in one pass per hop by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1306
* Bundles: refuse entries that share their data by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1303
* Tempo map: binary-search tempo segments in tick/sample conversions by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1297
* Clip gain to volume: index envelope lookups by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1309
* convert: keep a BWF source's bext chunk by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1314
* Stamp WAV bounces with their timecode position (BWF bext TimeReference) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1300
* audiosuite.process: say it takes built-in plugin ids, and why hosted ones are refused by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1302
* A new send opens its Send window, so its fader is on screen right away by @ljkx in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1291
* Show stereo input pairs for stereo tracks by @TheGalitube in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1279
* Delete markers on Alt-click by @TheGalitube in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1278
* soundcraft-cli: print logged warnings and errors to stderr by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1305
* Tell hosted plugins when they render offline (VST3 kOffline, clap.render) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1290
* Keep the edit cursor as the zoom reference when it is off-screen by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1286
* Plugin hosts: keep the system's reason when a plugin binary fails to load by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1316
* Toolbar: distinct link icons (#1262) and an Insertion Follows Playback toggle with its own icon (#1263) by @rahul05ranjan in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1281
* Indent tracks nested in folders by @TheGalitube in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1280
* fix(ui): center track names in edit window and remove unnecessary spacing for Solo and Mute buttons in Master tracks by @colliderman in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/576
* Tempo map: edit meters in linear time by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1324
* H.264: bound frame_num gaps, long-term references and SPS size by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1325
* engine: dedupe clip ids, clamp score bars per system, share autosave copies by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1333
* tests: create scratch folders exclusively by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1334
* Pass the Linux signing key to the release workflow by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1363
* Complete Grid and Nudge time scales by @SlyLaM in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/589
* fix(ui): About credits tables fit without side-scrolling and their columns resize by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1342
* feat(cli): commands --json lists every command's details (#744) by @ZIDAN44 in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1372
* fix(clap-host): check for the main thread off macOS too (#901) by @ZIDAN44 in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1371
* fix(engine): cap sessions at 256 MiB and parse them without a Value tree (#892) by @ZIDAN44 in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1370
* fix(ui): Strip Silence opens with t

detail.readme_excerpt:
SoundCraft

Recording, editing and mixing audio; an open-source, modern digital audio workstation (DAW), built in pure Rust.

A complete digital audio workstation that runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux and FreeBSD, and in the browser. Multitrack editing, a full mixer with plugins, sends and automation, MIDI, recording and bouncing, and every action scriptable from the command line or by an AI agent.


SoundCraft on getartcraft.com · ArtCraft · All Crafting Apps


The Edit window: tracks, waveforms, MIDI, rulers, markers and the transport, playing the built-in demo song (every sound in it is synthesised by SoundCraft itself).
